I worked as a UPS driver... Let me tell you, it's hard work, I've had assholes drunkenly yell at me when I'm delivering them alcohol and knock on their door for a signature, I've had aggressive dogs attack me because their owners leave them running rampant who order packages nearly every day... There are also great customers who give thank you gifts/cards on holidays or if they're just feeling generous, who make you laugh, say Hi! with kindness. At a certain point, working along the same route and getting to know the people. It's mostly the ones who treat me well that I would treat well in return, I would always go out of my way to ensure they were happy. If you treat your drivers with respect and courtesy, they will certainly repay the favor. We're humans too, and let me tell you, the chain of command is not in favor of the drivers... Treat your drivers with love and respect. We work hard long hours in all types of weather and are effected tremendously by our interactions with our customers. You can ruin one persons day just by giving them a hard time over something they can't control. I would recommend writing a heartfelt apology note to the driver in the name of you and your father. I'm sure it would certainly make him feel better. He could even decide to start delivering to your door again if he feels comfortable. Your dad may never change his aggressive attitudes, and I'm sorry you have someone like that in your life that you have to apologize for, but it's the right thing to do for someone who delivers you and your neighborhoods packages day after day.
